summary.text: Christina Hagan is the Republican candidate for the Ohio House of Representatives, District 48, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after winning the May 5, 2026 Republican primary.
She previously represented District 50 in the Ohio House from 2011 to 2018.

paragraphs.text: Christina Hagan assumed office in the Ohio House of Representatives, representing District 50, in 2011 and left office on December 31, 2018; Reggie Stoltzfus succeeded her.
In the 2017 legislative session she served on the Agriculture and Rural Development, Energy and Natural Resources (as vice chair) and Public Utilities committees.
Hagan was the Republican nominee for Ohio's 13th Congressional District in 2020 and lost to incumbent Tim Ryan.
In 2026, she defeated Ed Lohnes, Sue Grabowski and Greg Wolfe in the Republican primary for District 48.
